drift_findings.issue: SHORT_RSI_CEILING filter uses 5m candles but entry RSI uses 1m data
drift_findings.evidence: ETC SHORT entered at RSI=70.14 (>65 ceiling) but passed filter. Filter reads candles_5m, entry_rsi_14 computed from price_history (1m). Timeframe mismatch lets overbought SHORTs through.
drift_findings.impact: ETC SHORT loss -$0.28. DOT SHORT borderline at RSI=64.22.

drift_findings.evidence: Only 1 trade has exit_conditions populated. exit_reason works (atr_sl_hit, profit-monster-trail) but exit_conditions (which exit PATH was taken) is never written.
drift_findings.impact: Exit analysis impossible from DB. Cannot determine which exit mechanisms work best per signal/regime.

drift_findings.issue: Stale signal execution — 30.7% of 7d trades fire on stale signals
drift_findings.evidence: 82/267 trades have is_stale=true. Stale WR 50.0% vs fresh WR 58.2%. Stale PnL -$1.16 vs fresh +$2.69. Pullback-entry- SHORT: stale 56.1%WR +$0.10 vs fresh 65.0%WR +$2.55.
drift_findings.impact: ~$3.85/7d lost from stale execution. Fresh signals have 8.2% higher WR.

recurring_problems.data: 34.1% of 7d ATR SL exits close below entry (91/267). pullback-entry- SHORT: 68%. Structural — ATR SL fires before price moves in trade direction.
recurring_problems.status: MONITORING — ATR_SL_MIN=1.3% already applied, PM_TRAIL protected

recurring_problems.data: Only 2 signal types pass confluence in NEUTRAL: pullback-entry- SHORT and pump-chain- SHORT. System depends entirely on SHORT in flat market.

creative_improvements.idea: Align SHORT_RSI_CEILING filter to use 1m price data instead of 5m candles
creative_improvements.rationale: ETC SHORT entered at RSI=70.14 (1m data) but passed 5m RSI filter. 5m RSI smooths out spikes, letting overbought SHORTs through. Using 1m data matches the entry RSI and catches these.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Block ~2-3% of SHORT entries that currently slip through. ETC-type losses prevented.
creative_improvements.impact_on_winners: Need to verify: would 1m RSI filter have blocked any recent winners?

creative_improvements.idea: Add exit_conditions tracking to close_trade() — record which exit path fired
creative_improvements.rationale: 99.96% of trades have blank exit_conditions. We know exit_reason (atr_sl_hit, profit-monster-trail) but not which specific code path triggered. This makes exit analysis impossible.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Enable per-signal exit optimization. Identify which exits work best per regime.

creative_improvements.idea: Volume confirmation filter for pullback-entry- SHORT in EXTREME regime
creative_improvements.rationale: pullback-entry- SHORT: fresh 65.0%WR +$2.55 vs stale 56.1%WR +$0.10. Stale entries often chase already-moved price. Volume spike at entry = late chase. Adding volume ratio >1.5x filter would block late chasers.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Block ~5-10% of stale pullback-entry- SHORT entries. Improve WR from 60.5% to ~63-65%.
creative_improvements.risk: medium — needs 20+ trade sample to validate
